The manual `curl` smoke test was blocked by this session's sandbox (no approval surface available), but that's not a concern here — `test/serve.test.js` already exercises the server with real HTTP requests via `fetch`, which covers the same path.

**Summary:** Added `habit serve` — a zero-dependency `node:http` server (`src/serve.js`) that renders an HTML page listing each habit and its current streak, wired into `src/cli.js`, documented in the README, and covered by two new tests in `test/serve.test.js`. `npm test` passes (9/9).

Product decisions I made narrowly and didn't expand on: fixed port `3000`, no `--port` flag, no auto-refresh/live updates, no browser auto-open. If you want any of those, options would be: (a) add a `--port <n>` flag, (b) auto-refresh the page via a meta tag or polling, (c) auto-open the browser on start — happy to add any on request.
